title: Wizard city homepage — replacement petition including GitHub Pages publication (related to WO-ce0b2be1-7e0c-464b-b17c-814ad36e3ccd)
request: New resident-requested related petition. Predecessor: WO-ce0b2be1-7e0c-464b-b17c-814ad36e3ccd. The petition schema has no structured predecessor-link field; this textual reference is non-destructive and does not withdraw, amend, replace, or close the predecessor. Resident-selected outcome: Create a GitHub Pages homepage for the city that describes its management by the Repository City plugin, links to the plugin and the GitHub repository, and evokes a city for wizards without an Emerald City aesthetic. Extend the outcome to include enabling GitHub Pages and publishing the homepage, followed by live verification of its availability, expected content, and plugin and repository links at the confirmed public address. Registered project scope: city-homepage (docs). Do not assume a workflow, domain or address, hosting mechanism, or target. No change outside docs or increase in access or permissions is implied. Identify and review any such mechanism, external or outside-docs target, or required access before proposing action; no such work is included implicitly. Separate resident authorization is required before security or permission changes, deployment or Pages enablement, publication, or any other reserved matter. This petition is intake only, not authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage is suitable for hosting on GitHub Pages.
The homepage states that the city is managed by the Repository City plugin and links to the plugin and this GitHub repository.
The visual theme evokes a city for wizards and does not resemble the Emerald City.

GitHub Pages is enabled for the city-homepage project and the homepage is published at the confirmed public address, but only after separate resident authorization covering applicable security, deployment, publication, and any other reserved matter. Petition intake or preview is not that authorization.

Post-authorization live verification at the confirmed public address records that the page is reachable, contains the expected homepage content, and its plugin and repository links resolve to the confirmed intended destinations. Record the address, check time, evidence, and actual results; do not report an unperformed check as passed.

Delivery remains scoped to registered project city-homepage (docs). No change outside docs, workflow/domain/other-target assumption, or increase in access or permissions is implied.
